Read all four steps and eight current suppliers. Restrict the increasing Morse chart to a symmetric image (-R,R) with compact domain closure inside (a,b). Symmetrizing a compact-neighborhood bump gives an even cutoff. C5 inverse and C4 amplitude give A in C4 with compact support and A(0)=f(x0)/sqrt|g double prime(x0)|. Apply compact Jordan substitution only on K=Phi^-1([-r,r]) inside the chart. Constant phase factor has unit modulus, lambda=|omega| and sigma=sign(omega g double prime) give the correct leading phase for both frequency/curvature signs. Away from a neighborhood of x0, g prime has a positive minimum; h and its derivatives vanish at internal cuts, so the two r=2 expansions retain only a,b endpoints and O(|omega|^-2), bounded by the stated |omega|^-3/2 remainder for |omega|>=1. Zero f or f(x0)=0 is allowed; stationary endpoints/multiple critical points excluded.
